// ICTgaps: the gaps and ranges of ICTlevels (NDOG / NWOG / RTHOG with quadrants, octants and
// stddevs, and the premarket range), nothing else. Use it next to ICTday.

//@version=6
indicator("ICTgaps", overlay = true, max_lines_count = 500, max_boxes_count = 500,
     max_labels_count = 500, max_bars_back = 5000)

const color transparent = #ffffff00

getstyle(string s) =>
    switch s
        "dashed" => line.style_dashed
        "dotted" => line.style_dotted
        => line.style_solid

getsize(string s) =>
    switch s
        "tiny" => size.tiny
        "small" => size.small
        "large" => size.large
        "huge" => size.huge
        => size.normal

type Sty
    string sty
    int wid
    color col

const string G_EN = "Enable / Filter"
int attLvl = input.int(0, "Attenuation", minval = 0, maxval = 4, group = G_EN,
     tooltip = "Dims the drawings, 0: as configured, 4: the most dimmed. Levels have three ranks: important "
     + "(months, TGIF, NWOGs, the last NDOG, the current RTHOG), normal (day and session max/min, week lines, "
     + "the previous RTHOG, PMKT high / low, EQH / EQL, macro background) and minor (day lines, eq, M.O., older "
     + "NDOGs, old RTHOGs, RTHOG and PMKT quadrants, octants and stddevs). Each level dims minor drawings the "
     + "most and important ones the least; widths go down by 1 when dimmed enough. Session rectangles: filled "
     + "and lighter at 1, outline only from 2 on. Gap rectangles fade with the rank of their gap.")
// [ATT] dimming steps of a rank (0 important, 1 normal, 2 minor) at the attenuation level
attE(int rank) =>
    attLvl == 0 ? 0 : rank == 0 ? (attLvl >= 4 ? 2 : attLvl >= 2 ? 1 : 0) : rank == 1 ? attLvl : attLvl + 1
// line / text color, width and fill transparency of a rank
attL(color c, int rank) =>
    int e = attE(rank)
    e == 0 ? c : color.new(c, color.t(c) + (100 - color.t(c)) * math.min(e * 0.18, 0.9))
attW(int w, int rank) =>
    math.max(1, w - (attE(rank) >= 2 ? 1 : 0))
attT(int t, int rank) =>
    int(math.min(100, t + (100 - t) * attE(rank) * 0.2))

// ============================================================ timeframe, timezone, definitions
int tfsecs = timeframe.in_seconds()
int tfms = tfsecs * 1000
bool tfok = tfsecs <= 3600
bool rectOn = dorect and not (nolowrects and tfsecs < 900
     and tfsecs <= timeframe.in_seconds(rectmintf))
bool preOn = dopremarket and tfsecs <= 300
int rdx = tfsecs <= 60 ? 4 : 2

string lblsz = getsize(eqlblsize)
string dlblsz = getsize(dlblsize)
string tglsz = getsize(tglblsize)
string pmlsz = getsize(pmlblsize)
string slblsz = getsize(slblsize)
string tkr = str.upper(syminfo.ticker)
string dsc = str.upper(syminfo.description)
bool autoEU = str.contains(dsc, "DAX") or str.contains(tkr, "DAX") or str.contains(dsc, "GERMANY")
     or str.contains(tkr, "FDX")
bool useUS = TZ == "US" or (TZ == "Auto" and not autoEU)
string tz = useUS ? "America/New_York" : "Europe/Madrid"
string mktstr = useUS ? "0930-1615" : "0900-1730"
string gapstr = useUS ? "1700-1800" : "2300-0000"
string asiastr = useUS ? "2000-0000" : "2300-0600"
string londonstr = useUS ? "0200-0500" : "0800-1300"
string nyamstr = useUS ? "0700-1130" : "1330-1800"
string nypmstr = useUS ? "1330-1600" : "1900-2200"
string premarketstr = pmmode == "Manual" ? pmsession
     : (useUS ? "0700-0900" : "0630-0830")

var array<string> mNames = useUS ? array.from("NYpre", "NYAM.1", "NYAM.2", "NYAM.3", "NY.lunch",
     "NYPM", "NYLast", "MOC", "LDN.1", "LDN.2")
     : array.from("Dax7", "Dax8", "DaxOpen", "Dax10", "Dax11", "DaxTapas", "Dax17", "NYopen",
     "Dax19", "DaxLunch")
var array<string> mTimes = useUS ? array.from("0740-0810", "0850-0910", "0950-1010", "1050-1110",
     "1150-1210", "1310-1340", "1515-1530", "1545-1600", "0230-0300", "0403-0430")
     : array.from("0700-0710", "0750-0810", "0850-0910", "0955-1010", "1050-1110", "1245-1310",
     "1650-1710", "1515-1540", "1850-1910", "1350-1410")
var array<string> sbTimes = useUS ? array.from("1000-1100", "1400-1500") : array.from("1000-1100")

// time of day in seconds in the script timezone (bar open) and a few derived series
int tsec = hour(time, tz) * 3600 + minute(time, tz) * 60 + second(time, tz)
int tsecPrev = nz(tsec[1], tsec)
int dow = dayofweek(time, tz)
int dowPrev = nz(dow[1], dow)
bool newDay = dow != dowPrev
bool newWeek = (dow == dayofweek.sunday and dowPrev != dayofweek.sunday)
     or (dow == dayofweek.monday and dowPrev == dayofweek.friday)

// ============================================================ object budget (500 lines / labels /
// boxes)
int nsesEff = math.min(nses, 40)
int ngapsEff = math.min(ngaps, 15)
int gapKinds = (dondog ? 1 : 0) + (donwog ? 1 : 0)
int lnMonths = domonth ? 9 : 0
int lnGaps = dogaps ? gapKinds * 2 * ngapsEff : 0
int lnRth = dogaps and dorthog ? 4 * ngapsEff + 2 * rthogpo3num + 8 + (rthogauto ? 12 : 0)
     + (dorthogoct ? 4 : 0) : 0
int lnSes = doses ? 2 * nsesEff : 0
int lnPre = preOn ? 4 * nsesEff : 0
int lnPmx = preOn ? pmkeep * ((dopmq ? 3 : 0) + (dopmpo3 ? 2 * pmpo3num : 0) + (dopmq or dopmpo3 ? 2 : 0))
     + (pmauto and dopmpo3 ? 12 : 0) : 0
int lnEq = doeqhl ? (doeqd ? 4 : 2) * eqkeep : 0
int lbSes = doses and doseslbl ? 2 * nsesEff : 0
int lbPre = preOn and doseslbl ? 2 * nsesEff : 0
int lnTg = dotgif ? 2 : 0
int lnReserve = lnMonths + lnGaps + lnRth + lnSes + lnPre + lnPmx + lnEq + lnTg + 10
int lbReserve = lnMonths + lnGaps + lnRth + lbSes + lbPre + lnPmx + lnEq + lnTg + 10
int lnPerDay = (dolines ? 1 : 0) + (dodmaxmin ? 2 : 0) + (doeq ? 1 : 0) + (doopen ? 1 : 0)
int lbPerDay = (doeq ? 1 : 0) + (doopen ? 1 : 0) + (dodaylbl and dodmaxmin ? 2 : 0)
int daysByLn = lnPerDay > 0 ? math.floor((500 - lnReserve) / lnPerDay) : ndays
int daysByLb = lbPerDay > 0 ? math.floor((500 - lbReserve) / lbPerDay) : ndays
int ndaysEff = math.max(1, math.min(ndays, math.min(daysByLn, daysByLb)))
// the day cap is expected on 5m and lower charts (46 days with the defaults): no warning for it there
bool capped = (ndaysEff < ndays and tfsecs > 300) or nses > nsesEff or ngaps > ngapsEff

// ============================================================ processing window (history is
// limited for speed)
int spanMs = int((math.max(ndaysEff, ngapsEff) + 5) * 1.5 * 86400000)
int winEnd = visible ? chart.right_visible_bar_time : timenow
bool inWin = time <= winEnd and time >= winEnd - spanMs
bool finalBar = inWin and (barstate.islast or (visible and time_close > winEnd))

type ZoneInfo
    string name
    int ss      // start, seconds of day
    int es      // end, seconds of day
    Sty sty = na

type Zone
    string name
    int tstart

    float pwlo = na   // lowest low of the earlier days of the same week
    int hmode = 0     // 0 normal label, 1 REHs label, 2 no label (close to a higher high)
    int lmode = 0     // 0 normal label, 1 RELs label, 2 no label (close to a lower low)
    bool isday = false
    bool isweek = false
    bool dead = false
    bool drawmaxmin = true
    bool drawrect = false
    bool drawvlines = false
    bool drawlbl = false
    ZoneInfo zi = na

    Sty minsty = na
    box rect = na
    line vline = na
    line vline2 = na
    line maxln = na
    line minln = na
    line eqln = na
    line opln = na
    label maxlbl = na
    label minlbl = na
    label eqlabel = na
    label oplabel = na
    array<line> qlines = na     // premarket quadrant lines
    array<label> qlabels = na
    array<line> sdlines = na    // premarket stddev lines, in the order +1, -1, +2, -2...
    array<label> sdlabels = na
    array<string> sdnames = na  // their names: "+1", "-1"...
    float xhi = na    // premarket range: highest high / lowest low from its end to the market close (auto)
    float xlo = na

    int tstart
    float hi
    float lo

    int n = 1          // gaps grouped into this one (combine gaps)

    float uhi = na
    float ulo = na
    int ut = na
    line hiln = na
    line loln = na
    label hilbl = na
    label lolbl = na
    box rect = na

type Piv
    float p
    int t
    bool eq = false
    float pl = na   // price of the left (earlier) swing of the EQH / EQL
    float pr = na   // price of the right (later) swing
    line ln = na
    label lb = na

type MonLn
    line ln = na
    label lbl = na

// ============================================================ helpers
rmLine(line l) =>
    if not na(l)
        l.delete()

rmLabel(label l) =>
    if not na(l)
        l.delete()

rmBox(box b) =>
    if not na(b)
        b.delete()

tright(int n) =>
    time + n * tfms

// short date of t for labels: day of the month and the month, one letter when no other month starts with it
// (F, S, O, N, D), else three letters (Jan, Mar, Apr, May, Jun, Jul, Aug): 23O, 23Jul
sdate(int t) =>
    int m = month(t, tz)
    string mm = m == 2 ? "F" : m == 9 ? "S" : m == 10 ? "O" : m == 11 ? "N" : m == 12 ? "D"
         : str.format_time(t, "MMM", tz)
    str.tostring(dayofmonth(t, tz)) + mm

timestr() =>
    sdate(time)

mkLL(int x1, int x2, float p, color c, string sty, int w, string txt, color tc,
     string sz = size.normal) =>
    line l = line.new(x1, p, x2, p, xloc = xloc.bar_time, color = c, style = sty, width = w)
    label b = label.new(x2, p, txt, xloc = xloc.bar_time, style = label.style_label_left,
         color = transparent, textcolor = tc, size = sz)
    [l, b]

setR(line l, label b, int x, color c, int w = na) =>
    if not na(l)
        l.set_x2(x)
        l.set_color(c)
        if not na(w)
            l.set_width(w)
    if not na(b)
        b.set_x(x)
        b.set_textcolor(c)

tinyLbl(label cur, bool show, int x, float y, string txt, color c, string sz) =>
    label r = cur
    if show
        if na(r)
            r := label.new(x, y, txt, xloc = xloc.bar_time, style = label.style_label_left,
                 color = transparent, textcolor = c, size = sz)
        else
            r.set_xy(x, y)
            r.set_text(txt)
    else if not na(r)
        r.delete()
        r := na
    r

parseSecs(string s) =>
    60 * (60 * int(str.tonumber(str.substring(s, 0, 2))) + int(str.tonumber(str.substring(s, 2,
         4))))

mkZoneInfo(string name, string ival, Sty sty = na) =>
    ZoneInfo zi = na
    if name != "" and str.length(ival) >= 9
        zi := ZoneInfo.new(name, parseSecs(str.substring(ival, 0, 4)),
             parseSecs(str.substring(ival, 5, 9)), sty)
    zi

method inside(ZoneInfo z, int t) =>
    z.ss < z.es ? (t >= z.ss and t < z.es) : (t >= z.ss or t < z.es)

// the bar contains the start instant
method starts(ZoneInfo z) =>
    (z.ss - tsec + 86400) % 86400 < tfsecs

// the bar contains the end instant, or the session was left (data gaps)
method ends(ZoneInfo z) =>
    (z.es - tsec + 86400) % 86400 < tfsecs or (z.inside(tsecPrev) and not z.inside(tsec))

// ============================================================ styles and definitions
var Sty daysty = Sty.new(daylnsty, attW(daywid, 2), attL(daycol, 2))
var Sty daymaxsty = Sty.new(daymlnsty, attW(daymwid, 1), attL(daymmaxcol, 1))
var Sty dayminsty = Sty.new(daymlnsty, attW(daymwid, 1), attL(daymmincol, 1))
var Sty sesmaxsty = Sty.new(sesmlnsty, attW(sesmwid, 1), attL(sesmmaxcol, 1))
var Sty sesminsty = Sty.new(sesmlnsty, attW(sesmwid, 1), attL(sesmmincol, 1))
var Sty gapsty = Sty.new(gaplnsty, gapwid, gapcolor)
var Sty wgapsty = Sty.new(wgaplnsty, wgapwid, wgapcolor)
// [ATT] session rectangles: filled and lighter at attenuation 1, outline only from 2 on (fainter each level)
int rtrF = attLvl == 1 ? attT(rtransp, 1) : rtransp
bool rbord = rectbord or attLvl >= 2
int rtrB = attLvl >= 2 ? int(math.min(100, rtransp / 2 + (100 - rtransp / 2) * (attLvl - 1) * 0.2)) : int(rtransp / 2)
var Sty nysty = Sty.new(daylnsty, 1, color.new(uscolor, rtrF))
var Sty londonsty = Sty.new(daylnsty, 1, color.new(londoncolor, rtrF))
var Sty asiasty = Sty.new(daylnsty, 1, color.new(asiacolor, rtrF))

var ZoneInfo market = mkZoneInfo("market", mktstr)
var ZoneInfo asia = mkZoneInfo("Asia", asiastr, asiasty)
var ZoneInfo london = mkZoneInfo("London", londonstr, londonsty)
var ZoneInfo nyam = mkZoneInfo("NY AM", nyamstr, nysty)
var ZoneInfo nypm = mkZoneInfo("NY PM", nypmstr, nysty)
var ZoneInfo premarket = mkZoneInfo("Pre-mkt", premarketstr, nysty)
var array<ZoneInfo> zinfos = array.from(asia, london, nyam, nypm)
var array<ZoneInfo> macros = array.new<ZoneInfo>()
var array<ZoneInfo> sbs = array.new<ZoneInfo>()

if barstate.isfirst
    for i = 0 to mNames.size() - 1
        macros.push(mkZoneInfo(mNames.get(i), mTimes.get(i)))
    for i = 0 to sbTimes.size() - 1
        sbs.push(mkZoneInfo("S.Bullet", sbTimes.get(i)))
    if capped
        log.info("object budget: days {0}->{1}, sessions {2}->{3}, gaps {4}->{5}", ndays, ndaysEff,
             nses, nsesEff, ngaps, ngapsEff)

int gapStartSec = parseSecs(str.substring(gapstr, 0, 4))
int gapEndSec = parseSecs(str.substring(gapstr, 5, 9))

var array<Zone> days = array.new<Zone>()
var array<Zone> zones = array.new<Zone>()
var array<Zone> premarkets = array.new<Zone>()
var array<Zone> actz = array.new<Zone>()   // zones still growing
var array<Zone> monz = array.new<Zone>()   // ended zones with unbroken max/min
var array<Gap> dgaps = array.new<Gap>()
var array<Gap> wgaps = array.new<Gap>()
var array<RTHOG> rthogs = array.new<RTHOG>()
var array<Piv> hpv = array.new<Piv>()
var array<Piv> lpv = array.new<Piv>()
var array<Piv> hpvD = array.new<Piv>()
var array<Piv> lpvD = array.new<Piv>()
var array<MonLn> mls = array.new<MonLn>()
var Gap ndog = na

if barstate.isfirst
    for i = 0 to 8
        mls.push(MonLn.new())

// ============================================================ automatic stddevs
// stddevs to draw on one side of a range: at least n; with auto, also every stddev reached by the extreme
// ext (base: the range edge on that side, u: the step, sgn 1 above, -1 below) plus the next one
sdCount(int n, bool auto, float base, float u, float ext, int sgn) =>
    int r = n
    if auto and not na(ext) and u > 0
        int reached = math.max(0, int(math.floor((ext - base) * sgn / u)))
        r := math.max(n, math.min(reached + 1, 40))
    r

// stddev name: distance from the range edge in whole ranges (step i of u, range r), for example "+0.25", "-1.5"
sdName(int i, float u, float r, int sgn) =>
    (sgn > 0 ? "+" : "-") + str.tostring(i * u / r, "#.###")

// ============================================================ zones
mkZone(string name, ZoneInfo zi = na) =>
    Zone z = Zone.new(name, time, open, high, low, time, time)
    z.zi := zi
    z

// premarket quadrant and stddev objects
method pmclear(Zone z) =>
    if not na(z.qlines)
        for l in z.qlines
            rmLine(l)
        z.qlines.clear()
    if not na(z.qlabels)
        for b in z.qlabels
            rmLabel(b)
        z.qlabels.clear()
    if not na(z.sdlines)
        for l in z.sdlines
            rmLine(l)
        z.sdlines.clear()
    if not na(z.sdlabels)
        for b in z.sdlabels
            rmLabel(b)
        z.sdlabels.clear()
    true

// quadrants (25%, CE, 75%) and stddevs of the range, like the RTHOG ones. Drawn from a
// couple of bars before the end of the range (or the last bar while it is forming)
method pmdraw(Zone z, bool auto = false) =>
    z.pmclear()
    float r = z.hi - z.lo
    int x1 = na(z.tclose) ? tright(xoff) : math.min(tright(xoff), z.tclose)
    int x0 = (na(z.tend) ? time : z.tend) - tfms * rdx
    string nm = sdate(z.tstart)
    if r > 0
        if dopmq and r / 4.0 > pmqmin
            if na(z.qlines)
                z.qlines := array.new<line>()
                z.qlabels := array.new<label>()
            for k = 1 to 3
                string pt = k == 1 ? "dq" : k == 2 ? "ce" : "uq"
                [l1, b1] = mkLL(x0, x1, z.lo + k * r / 4.0, attL(pmcolor, 2), k == 2 ? pmcesty : pmqsty,
                     attW(pmwid, 2), "PMKT " + pt + " " + nm, attL(pmcolor, 2), pmlsz)
                z.qlines.push(l1)
                z.qlabels.push(b1)
        if dopmpo3
            float u = 0.0
            if r / 8 > pmpo3min
                u := r / 8
            else if r / 4 > pmpo3min
                u := r / 4
            else if r / 2 > pmpo3min
                u := r / 2
            else if r > pmpo3min
                u := r
            if u > 0
                if na(z.sdlines)
                    z.sdlines := array.new<line>()
                    z.sdlabels := array.new<label>()
                    z.sdnames := array.new<string>()
                z.sdnames.clear()
                int nu = sdCount(pmpo3num, auto, z.hi, u, z.xhi, 1)
                int nd = sdCount(pmpo3num, auto, z.lo, u, z.xlo, -1)
                for i = 1 to math.max(nu, nd)
                    if i <= nu
                        [l2, b2] = mkLL(x0, x1, z.hi + i * u, attL(pmcolor, 2), pmpo3sty, attW(pmwid, 2),
                             "PMKT" + sdName(i, u, r, 1), attL(pmcolor, 2), pmlsz)
                        z.sdlines.push(l2)
                        z.sdlabels.push(b2)
                        z.sdnames.push(sdName(i, u, r, 1))
                    if i <= nd
                        [l3, b3] = mkLL(x0, x1, z.lo - i * u, attL(pmcolor, 2), pmpo3sty, attW(pmwid, 2),
                             "PMKT" + sdName(i, u, r, -1), attL(pmcolor, 2), pmlsz)
                        z.sdlines.push(l3)
                        z.sdlabels.push(b3)
                        z.sdnames.push(sdName(i, u, r, -1))
        // high and low of the range, red solid lines, whenever quadrants or stddevs are drawn
        bool anyq = not na(z.qlines) and z.qlines.size() > 0
        bool anysd = not na(z.sdlines) and z.sdlines.size() > 0
        if anyq or anysd
            if na(z.qlines)
                z.qlines := array.new<line>()
                z.qlabels := array.new<label>()
            [lh, bh] = mkLL(x0, x1, z.hi, attL(pmcolor, 1), line.style_solid, attW(pmwid, 1), "PMKT hi " + nm, attL(pmcolor, 1),
                 pmlsz)
            z.qlines.push(lh)
            z.qlabels.push(bh)
            [ll, bl] = mkLL(x0, x1, z.lo, attL(pmcolor, 1), line.style_solid, attW(pmwid, 1), "PMKT lo " + nm, attL(pmcolor, 1),
                 pmlsz)
            z.qlines.push(ll)
            z.qlabels.push(bl)
    true

method kill(Zone z) =>
    z.dead := true
    z.pmclear()
    rmBox(z.rect)
    rmLine(z.vline)
    rmLine(z.vline2)
    rmLine(z.maxln)
    rmLine(z.minln)
    rmLine(z.eqln)
    rmLine(z.opln)
    rmLabel(z.maxlbl)
    rmLabel(z.minlbl)
    rmLabel(z.eqlabel)
    rmLabel(z.oplabel)

// create or update every object of the zone from its current state
method refresh(Zone z) =>
    int re = tright(2)
    if not na(z.tclose)
        re := math.min(re, z.tclose)
    int xe = na(z.tend) ? re : z.tend
    if z.drawvlines or (z.isday and dolines)
        if na(z.vline)
            z.vline := line.new(z.tstart, z.lo, z.tstart, z.hi + syminfo.mintick,
                 extend = extend.both, xloc = xloc.bar_time,
                 color = z.isweek ? attL(daycol, 1) : z.lnsty.col, style = z.isweek ? wdaylnsty : z.lnsty.sty,
                 width = z.isweek ? attW(wdaywid, 1) : z.lnsty.wid)
        if z.drawvlines and not na(z.tend) and na(z.vline2)
            int x2 = z.tend + tfms
            z.vline2 := line.new(x2, z.lo, x2, z.hi + syminfo.mintick, extend = extend.both,
                 xloc = xloc.bar_time,
                 color = z.lnsty.col, style = z.lnsty.sty, width = z.lnsty.wid)
    if z.drawmaxmin
        int hx = na(z.hidonet) ? re : math.min(z.hidonet, re)
        int lx = na(z.lodonet) ? re : math.min(z.lodonet, re)
        if na(z.maxln)
            z.maxln := line.new(z.hit, z.hi, hx, z.hi, xloc = xloc.bar_time, color = z.maxsty.col,
                 width = z.maxsty.wid, style = z.maxsty.sty)
        else
            z.maxln.set_xy1(z.hit, z.hi)
            z.maxln.set_xy2(hx, z.hi)
        if na(z.minln)
            z.minln := line.new(z.lot, z.lo, lx, z.lo, xloc = xloc.bar_time, color = z.minsty.col,
                 width = z.minsty.wid, style = z.minsty.sty)
        else
            z.minln.set_xy1(z.lot, z.lo)
            z.minln.set_xy2(lx, z.lo)
        if z.drawlbl
            string lsz = z.isday ? dlblsz : slblsz
            string hn = z.name + " hi"
            string ln = z.name + " lo"
            if z.isday
                hn := na(z.pwhi) or z.hi >= z.pwhi ? "week high" : "day high"
                ln := na(z.pwlo) or z.lo <= z.pwlo ? "week low" : "day low"
                if z.hmode == 1
                    hn := "day REHs"
                if z.lmode == 1
                    ln := "day RELs"
            z.maxlbl := tinyLbl(z.maxlbl, na(z.hidonet) and z.hmode != 2, re, z.hi, hn,
                 z.maxsty.col, lsz)
            z.minlbl := tinyLbl(z.minlbl, na(z.lodonet) and z.lmode != 2, re, z.lo, ln,
                 z.minsty.col, lsz)
    if z.isday and doeq
        float eq = math.avg(z.hi, z.lo)
        int ex = na(z.extendt) ? re : z.extendt
        int x0 = math.min(z.hit, z.lot)
        if na(z.eqln)
            z.eqln := line.new(x0, eq, ex, eq, xloc = xloc.bar_time, color = attL(eqcolor, 2), width = attW(eqwid, 2),
                 style = eqlnsty)
            z.eqlabel := label.new(ex, eq, "eq", xloc = xloc.bar_time,
                 style = label.style_label_left, color = transparent, textcolor = attL(eqcolor, 2))
        else
            z.eqln.set_xy1(x0, eq)
            z.eqln.set_xy2(ex, eq)
            z.eqlabel.set_xy(ex, eq)
    if z.isday and doopen
        if na(z.opln)
            z.opln := line.new(z.tstart, z.op, xe, z.op, xloc = xloc.bar_time, color = attL(opcolor, 2),
                 width = attW(opwid, 2), style = oplnsty)
            z.oplabel := label.new(xe, z.op, "M.O.", xloc = xloc.bar_time,
                 style = label.style_label_left, color = transparent, textcolor = attL(opcolor, 2))
        else
            z.opln.set_x2(xe)
            z.oplabel.set_x(xe)
    if z.drawrect
        if na(z.rect)
            z.rect := box.new(z.tstart, z.hi, xe, z.lo, xloc = xloc.bar_time,
                 border_color = rbord ? color.new(z.lnsty.col, rtrB) : transparent,
                 border_width = rbord and attLvl < 3 ? 2 : 1, bgcolor = rbord ? transparent : z.lnsty.col)
        else
            z.rect.set_right(xe)
            z.rect.set_top(z.hi)
            z.rect.set_bottom(z.lo)
    z

// needs right-edge updates on the last bar
method live(Zone z) =>
    na(z.tend) or (z.drawmaxmin and (na(z.hidonet) or na(z.lodonet))) or (z.isday and na(z.extendt))

// only state, no drawing: cheap per bar
method upd(Zone z) =>
    if high >= z.hi
        z.hit := time
        z.hi := high
    if low <= z.lo
        z.lot := time
        z.lo := low

endZone(Zone z) =>
    if na(z.tend)
        z.tend := time[1]
        z.refresh()
        if z.drawmaxmin
            monz.push(z)

runActive() =>
    int i = actz.size() - 1
    while i >= 0
        Zone z = actz.get(i)
        if z.dead or not na(z.tend)
            actz.remove(i)
        else if not na(z.zi) and z.zi.ends()
            endZone(z)
            actz.remove(i)
        else
            z.upd()
        i -= 1

// unbroken day highs (lows) close to each other: the lines stay, but only the higher high
// (lower low) keeps a label, which reads REHs (RELs)
markRel(array<Zone> arr, float tol) =>
    int n = arr.size()
    if n > 0
        for i = 0 to n - 1
            Zone a = arr.get(i)
            a.hmode := 0
            a.lmode := 0
            for j = 0 to n - 1
                if j != i
                    Zone b = arr.get(j)
                    if na(a.hidonet) and na(b.hidonet) and math.abs(a.hi - b.hi) <= tol
                        if b.hi > a.hi or (b.hi == a.hi and j > i)
                            a.hmode := 2
                        else if a.hmode == 0
                            a.hmode := 1
                    if na(a.lodonet) and na(b.lodonet) and math.abs(a.lo - b.lo) <= tol
                        if b.lo < a.lo or (b.lo == a.lo and j > i)
                            a.lmode := 2
                        else if a.lmode == 0
                            a.lmode := 1

    true

// ended zones: only watch for the max/min being taken
runMon() =>
    int i = monz.size() - 1
    while i >= 0
        Zone z = monz.get(i)
        if z.dead
            monz.remove(i)
        else
            bool ch = false
            if na(z.hidonet) and high > z.hi
                z.hidonet := time
                ch := true
            if na(z.lodonet) and low < z.lo
                z.lodonet := time
                ch := true
            if ch
                z.refresh()
            if not na(z.hidonet) and not na(z.lodonet)
                monz.remove(i)
        i -= 1

if inWin and tfok
    if newDay
        Zone d = mkZone("D")
        d.isday := true
        d.isweek := newWeek
        d.lnsty := daysty
        d.maxsty := daymaxsty
        d.minsty := dayminsty
        d.drawmaxmin := dodmaxmin
        d.drawlbl := dodaylbl
        if days.size() > 0
            Zone ld = days.last()
            if not d.isweek
                d.pwhi := na(ld.pwhi) ? ld.hi : math.max(ld.pwhi, ld.hi)
                d.pwlo := na(ld.pwlo) ? ld.lo : math.min(ld.pwlo, ld.lo)
            endZone(ld)
            if days.size() > 1
                Zone pd = days.get(days.size() - 2)
                pd.extendt := ld.tend
                pd.refresh()
        days.push(d)
        actz.push(d)
        if days.size() > ndaysEff
            days.shift().kill()
    if doses
        for zi in zinfos
            if zi.starts()
                Zone s = mkZone(zi.name, zi)
                s.drawmaxmin := dosmaxmin
                s.drawrect := rectOn
                s.drawlbl := doseslbl
                s.lnsty := zi.sty
                s.maxsty := sesmaxsty
                s.minsty := sesminsty
                zones.push(s)
                actz.push(s)
                if zones.size() > nsesEff
                    zones.shift().kill()
    if preOn and premarket.starts()
        Zone p = mkZone(premarket.name, premarket)
        p.drawmaxmin := dosmaxmin
        p.drawvlines := true
        // lines stop at the market close (end of the market window, in tz seconds of day)
        p.tclose := time + ((market.es - tsec + 86400) % 86400) * 1000
        p.drawlbl := doseslbl
        p.lnsty := daysty
        p.maxsty := sesmaxsty
        p.minsty := sesminsty
        premarkets.push(p)
        actz.push(p)
        if premarkets.size() > nsesEff
            premarkets.shift().kill()
    runActive()
    runMon()

// ============================================================ TGIF
// Week candle (from newWeek) tracked here. On the first bar of Friday the week so far is tested: a
// displacement (price within tgnear x range of the week high / low, whatever the body) arms the
// levels, measured from the week high (bullish, retracement down) or low
// (bearish, retracement up). On Friday they follow new week extremes until price reaches the first
// level, then stay fixed. When the week closes displaced and the retracement did not happen on Friday,
// the levels of the final week apply on Monday (until Tuesday starts). Otherwise they are removed when
// the day ends.
tgEval(float h, float l, float c) =>
    float r = h - l
    int d = 0
    if r > 0
        if h - c <= tgnear * r
            d := 1
        else if c - l <= tgnear * r
            d := -1
    d

var float twO = na      // week open, high, low
var float twH = na
var float twL = na
var int tgDir = 0       // 1: bullish week, retracement down; -1: bearish week, retracement up; 0: none
var bool tgMon = false  // levels carried to Monday
var bool tgHit = false  // the first level was reached (the levels stay fixed)
var float tgX = na      // extreme and range the levels are measured from
var float tgR = na
var int tgT0 = na       // start of the lines
var line tgL1 = na
var line tgL2 = na
var label tgB1 = na
var label tgB2 = na

if inWin and tfok and dotgif
    bool clr = false
    if newWeek
        int d = na(twO) ? 0 : tgEval(twH, twL, close[1])
        bool carry = d != 0 and not (tgDir == d and tgHit)
        clr := true
        tgDir := 0
        tgMon := false
        tgHit := false
        if carry
            tgDir := d
            tgMon := true
            tgX := d == 1 ? twH : twL
            tgR := twH - twL
            tgT0 := time
        twO := open
        twH := high
        twL := low
    else if not na(twO)
        if newDay and dow == dayofweek.friday
            clr := true
            tgDir := tgEval(twH, twL, close[1])
            tgMon := false
            tgHit := false
            tgT0 := time
        else if newDay and tgDir != 0 and not (tgMon and dow == dayofweek.monday)
            // Friday or Monday is over (Monday levels start with the week, before Monday's midnight)
            clr := true
            tgDir := 0
            tgMon := false
        twH := math.max(twH, high)
        twL := math.min(twL, low)
    if clr
        rmLine(tgL1)
        rmLine(tgL2)
        rmLabel(tgB1)
        rmLabel(tgB2)
        tgL1 := na
        tgL2 := na
        tgB1 := na
        tgB2 := na
    if tgDir != 0
        if not tgMon and not tgHit
            tgX := tgDir == 1 ? twH : twL
            tgR := twH - twL
        float v1 = tgX - tgDir * tgp1 * tgR
        float v2 = tgX - tgDir * tgp2 * tgR
        color c = attL(tgDir == 1 ? tgdncol : tgupcol, 0)
        int x1 = tright(xoff)
        if na(tgL1)
            [l1, b1] = mkLL(tgT0, x1, v1, c, tgsty, attW(tgwid, 0), "TGIF" + str.tostring(tgp1 * 100, "#.#"), c,
                 tglsz)
            [l2, b2] = mkLL(tgT0, x1, v2, c, tgsty, attW(tgwid, 0), "TGIF" + str.tostring(tgp2 * 100, "#.#"), c,
                 tglsz)
            tgL1 := l1
            tgB1 := b1
            tgL2 := l2
            tgB2 := b2
        else
            tgL1.set_y1(v1)
            tgL1.set_y2(v1)
            tgL1.set_x2(x1)
            tgB1.set_xy(x1, v1)
            tgL2.set_y1(v2)
            tgL2.set_y2(v2)
            tgL2.set_x2(x1)
            tgB2.set_xy(x1, v2)
        if not tgHit and (tgDir == 1 ? low <= v1 : high >= v1)
            tgHit := true

// ============================================================ NDOG / NWOG
// create the lines, labels and rectangle of a gap
method gmake(Gap g) =>
    Sty st = g.isw ? wgapsty : gapsty
    int x = tright(xoff)
    g.hiln := line.new(g.tstart, g.hi, x, g.hi, xloc = xloc.bar_time, color = st.col,
         style = st.sty, width = st.wid)
    g.loln := line.new(g.tstart, g.lo, x, g.lo, xloc = xloc.bar_time, color = st.col,
         style = st.sty, width = st.wid)
    g.hilbl := label.new(x, g.hi, g.name, xloc = xloc.bar_time, style = label.style_label_left,
         color = transparent, textcolor = st.col)
    g.lolbl := label.new(x, g.lo, g.name, xloc = xloc.bar_time, style = label.style_label_left,
         color = transparent, textcolor = st.col)
    if dogrect
        g.rect := box.new(g.tstart, g.hi, x, g.lo, xloc = xloc.bar_time, border_color = transparent,
             bgcolor = color.new(st.col, grtransp))
    true

// [ATT] colors and widths of the gap by its rank (last bar)
method gsty(Gap g) =>
    int rk = g.isw or g.imp ? 0 : 2
    Sty st = g.isw ? wgapsty : gapsty
    color c = attL(st.col, rk)
    int w = attW(st.wid, rk)
    if not na(g.hiln)
        g.hiln.set_color(c)
        g.hiln.set_width(w)
        g.loln.set_color(c)
        g.loln.set_width(w)
    if not na(g.hilbl)
        g.hilbl.set_textcolor(c)
    if not na(g.lolbl)
        g.lolbl.set_textcolor(c)
    if not na(g.rect)
        g.rect.set_bgcolor(color.new(st.col, attT(grtransp, rk)))
    true

method gend(Gap g, float xe) =>
    float s = g.hi
    g.hi := math.max(s, xe)
    g.lo := math.min(s, xe)
    g.name := (g.isw ? "NWOG " : "NDOG ") + timestr()
    g.gmake()

// text of the gap without the date: plain, or combined (NDOGx3, NWOGx2, NWOG+NDOG)
method gname(Gap g) =>
    string b = str.substring(g.name, 0, 4)
    if g.isw and g.nd > 0
        b := (g.n > 1 ? "NWOGx" + str.tostring(g.n) : "NWOG") + "+NDOG"
             + (g.nd > 1 ? "x" + str.tostring(g.nd) : "")
    else if g.n > 1
        b := (g.isw ? "NWOGx" : "NDOGx") + str.tostring(g.n)
    b

// labels of the levels h and l: two labels "NDOGx3 hi 23O" / "NDOGx3 lo 23O", or a single one in the middle
// ("NDOGx3 23O") when the levels are within tol of each other. The date is the one of the gap that draws them.
method glabels(Gap g, float h, float l, float tol, int x) =>
    bool small = math.abs(h - l) <= tol
    string b = g.gname()
    string dt = " " + str.substring(g.name, 5)
    Sty gs = g.isw ? wgapsty : gapsty
    g.hilbl.set_xy(x, small ? math.avg(h, l) : h)
    g.hilbl.set_text(small ? b + dt : b + " hi" + dt)
    if small
        rmLabel(g.lolbl)
        g.lolbl := na
    else
        if na(g.lolbl)
            g.lolbl := label.new(x, l, b + " lo" + dt, xloc = xloc.bar_time,
                 style = label.style_label_left, color = transparent, textcolor = gs.col)
        g.lolbl.set_xy(x, l)
        g.lolbl.set_text(b + " lo" + dt)
    true

method gright(Gap g, float tol) =>
    int x = tright(xoff)
    if not na(g.hiln)
        g.hiln.set_x2(x)
        g.loln.set_x2(x)
        g.glabels(g.hi, g.lo, tol, x)
    if not na(g.rect)
        g.rect.set_right(x)
    g.gsty()

method kill(Gap g) =>
    rmLine(g.hiln)
    rmLine(g.loln)
    rmLabel(g.hilbl)
    rmLabel(g.lolbl)
    rmBox(g.rect)
    g.hiln := na
    g.loln := na
    g.hilbl := na
    g.lolbl := na
    g.rect := na

// ---- combining gaps at similar levels (derived state, recomputed on the last bar)
method gcomb(Gap g, float tol) =>
    if not g.show
        g.kill()
    else
        if na(g.hiln)
            g.gmake()
        int x = tright(xoff)
        g.hiln.set_xy1(g.ut, g.uhi)
        g.hiln.set_xy2(x, g.uhi)
        g.loln.set_xy1(g.ut, g.ulo)
        g.loln.set_xy2(x, g.ulo)
        g.glabels(g.uhi, g.ulo, tol, x)
        if not na(g.rect)
            g.rect.set_lefttop(g.ut, g.uhi)
            g.rect.set_rightbottom(x, g.ulo)
        g.gsty()
    true

// gaps whose ranges overlap or are within tol are one group: the oldest draws the
// outer levels of the group, the others are hidden
gcluster(array<Gap> arr, float tol) =>
    int n = arr.size()
    // a for loop from 0 to n - 1 runs backwards when n = 0, so an empty list is skipped
    if n > 0
        array<int> cid = array.new<int>()
        for i = 0 to n - 1
            Gap g = arr.get(i)
            g.n := 1
            g.nd := 0
            g.show := true
            g.uhi := g.hi
            g.ulo := g.lo
            g.ut := g.tstart
            cid.push(i)
        bool ch = n > 1
        while ch
            ch := false
            for i = 0 to n - 2
                for j = i + 1 to n - 1
                    if cid.get(i) != cid.get(j)
                        Gap a = arr.get(i)
                        Gap b = arr.get(j)
                        if a.hi + tol >= b.lo and b.hi + tol >= a.lo
                            int from = cid.get(j)
                            int xto = cid.get(i)
                            for k = 0 to n - 1
                                if cid.get(k) == from
                                    cid.set(k, xto)
                            ch := true
        array<int> first = array.new<int>(n, -1)
        for i = 0 to n - 1
            int c = cid.get(i)
            int r = first.get(c)
            if r < 0
                first.set(c, i)
            else
                Gap rep = arr.get(r)
                Gap g = arr.get(i)
                rep.n += 1
                rep.uhi := math.max(rep.uhi, g.hi)
                rep.ulo := math.min(rep.ulo, g.lo)
                rep.imp := rep.imp or g.imp
                g.show := false

    true

combineGaps(array<Gap> dg, array<Gap> wg, float tol) =>
    gcluster(dg, tol)
    gcluster(wg, tol)
    for w in wg
        if w.show
            for d in dg
                if d.show and math.abs(d.uhi - w.uhi) <= tol and math.abs(d.ulo - w.ulo) <= tol
                    w.nd += d.n
                    w.imp := w.imp or d.imp
                    d.show := false
    for g in dg
        g.gcomb(tol)
    for g in wg
        g.gcomb(tol)
    true

bool gapOpenBar = tsec == gapStartSec
bool gapCloseBar = (tsec + tfsecs) % 86400 == gapStartSec
bool gapEndBar = tsec == gapEndSec
bool isWeekGap = dow == dayofweek.friday or dow == dayofweek.sunday

if inWin and dogaps and tfok and bar_index > 0
    if gapOpenBar or gapCloseBar
        int si = gapOpenBar ? 1 : 0
        if (isWeekGap and donwog) or (not isWeekGap and dondog)
            ndog := Gap.new((isWeekGap ? "NWOG " : "NDOG ") + timestr(), time[si], close[si], na,
                 isWeekGap)
    else if dow == dayofweek.sunday and dowPrev == dayofweek.friday and donwog
        ndog := Gap.new("NWOG " + timestr(), time[1], close[1], na, true)
    if not na(ndog) and gapEndBar
        ndog.gend(open)
        array<Gap> lst = ndog.isw ? wgaps : dgaps
        lst.push(ndog)
        if lst.size() > ngapsEff
            lst.shift().kill()
        ndog := na

// ============================================================ RTHOG
method killq(RTHOG g) =>
    rmLine(g.uqline)
    rmLine(g.dqline)
    rmLabel(g.uqlabel)
    rmLabel(g.dqlabel)
    g.uqline := na
    g.dqline := na
    g.uqlabel := na
    g.dqlabel := na

method killpo3(RTHOG g) =>
    if not na(g.po3lines)
        for l in g.po3lines
            rmLine(l)
        g.po3lines.clear()
    if not na(g.po3labels)
        for b in g.po3labels
            rmLabel(b)
        g.po3labels.clear()

method killoct(RTHOG g) =>
    if not na(g.oclines)
        for l in g.oclines
            rmLine(l)
        g.oclines.clear()
    if not na(g.oclabels)
        for b in g.oclabels
            rmLabel(b)
        g.oclabels.clear()

method kill(RTHOG g) =>
    g.killoct()
    rmLine(g.cline)
    rmLine(g.mline)
    rmLine(g.cline2)
    rmLine(g.opline)
    rmLabel(g.clabel)
    rmLabel(g.mlabel)
    rmLabel(g.clabel2)
    rmLabel(g.oplabel)
    rmBox(g.rect)
    g.cline := na
    g.mline := na
    g.cline2 := na
    g.opline := na
    g.clabel := na
    g.mlabel := na
    g.clabel2 := na
    g.oplabel := na
    g.rect := na
    g.killq()
    g.killpo3()

// market close: settlement price line (value and bar time of the last bar of the session)
method rstarts(RTHOG g, float c, int t) =>
    g.cl := c
    g.tstart := t
    int x = tright(xoff)
    g.cline := line.new(t, c, x, c, xloc = xloc.bar_time, color = attL(lrgapcolor, 0), width = attW(rgapwid, 0),
         style = rgaplnsty)
    g.clabel := label.new(x, c, "new RTHOG settlement", xloc = xloc.bar_time,
         style = label.style_label_left, color = transparent, textcolor = attL(lrgapcolor, 0))

method rquads(RTHOG g) =>
    g.killq()
    float qdy = math.abs(g.op - g.cl) / 4.0
    if qdy > rthogqmin
        float p = math.min(g.cl, g.op)
        int x0 = g.tend - tfms * rdx
        int x1 = tright(xoff)
        string nm = timestr()
        [l1, b1] = mkLL(x0, x1, p + qdy, attL(lrgapcolor, 2), rgapqlnsty, attW(rgapwid, 2), "RTHOG dq " + nm,
             attL(lrgapcolor, 2))
        g.dqline := l1
        g.dqlabel := b1
        [l2, b2] = mkLL(x0, x1, p + 3 * qdy, attL(lrgapcolor, 2), rgapqlnsty, attW(rgapwid, 2), "RTHOG uq " + nm,
             attL(lrgapcolor, 2))
        g.uqline := l2
        g.uqlabel := b2

// octants: 1/8, 3/8, 5/8, 7/8 of the gap, from the open to noon (or the right edge before noon)
method roct(RTHOG g) =>
    g.killoct()
    float ody = math.abs(g.op - g.cl) / 8.0
    g.noon := timestamp(tz, year(g.tend, tz), month(g.tend, tz), dayofmonth(g.tend, tz), 12, 0)
    int x0 = g.tend - tfms * rdx
    int x1 = math.min(tright(xoff), g.noon)
    if ody > rthogqmin and x1 > x0
        if na(g.oclines)
            g.oclines := array.new<line>()
            g.oclabels := array.new<label>()
        float p = math.min(g.cl, g.op)
        string nm = timestr()
        for k in array.from(1, 3, 5, 7)
            [l, b] = mkLL(x0, x1, p + k * ody, attL(lrgapcolor, 2), rgapqlnsty, 1, "RTHOG " + str.tostring(k)
                 + "/8 " + nm, attL(lrgapcolor, 2))
            g.oclines.push(l)
            g.oclabels.push(b)

// last bar: the octants follow the right edge until noon
method octRight(RTHOG g, color c) =>
    if not na(g.oclines) and not na(g.noon)
        int x = math.min(tright(xoff), g.noon)
        for l in g.oclines
            l.set_x2(x)
            l.set_color(c)
        for b in g.oclabels
            b.set_x(x)
            b.set_textcolor(c)

method rpo3(RTHOG g) =>
    g.killpo3()
    float gap = math.abs(g.op - g.cl)
    float u = 0.0
    if gap / 8 > rthogpo3min
        u := gap / 8
    else if gap / 4 > rthogpo3min
        u := gap / 4
    else if gap / 2 > rthogpo3min
        u := gap / 2
    else if gap > rthogpo3min
        u := gap
    if u > 0
        if na(g.po3lines)
            g.po3lines := array.new<line>()
            g.po3labels := array.new<label>()
            g.po3names := array.new<string>()
        g.po3names.clear()
        int x0 = g.tend - tfms * rdx
        int x1 = tright(xoff)
        float pu0 = math.max(g.cl, g.op)
        float pd0 = math.min(g.cl, g.op)
        int nu = sdCount(rthogpo3num, rthogauto, pu0, u, g.xhi, 1)
        int nd = sdCount(rthogpo3num, rthogauto, pd0, u, g.xlo, -1)
        for i = 1 to math.max(nu, nd)
            if i <= nu
                [l1, b1] = mkLL(x0, x1, pu0 + i * u, attL(lrgapcolor, 2), rgappo3lnsty, attW(rgapwid, 2),
                     "RTHOG" + sdName(i, u, gap, 1), attL(lrgapcolor, 2))
                g.po3lines.push(l1)
                g.po3labels.push(b1)
                g.po3names.push(sdName(i, u, gap, 1))
            if i <= nd
                [l2, b2] = mkLL(x0, x1, pd0 - i * u, attL(lrgapcolor, 2), rgappo3lnsty, attW(rgapwid, 2),
                     "RTHOG" + sdName(i, u, gap, -1), attL(lrgapcolor, 2))
                g.po3lines.push(l2)
                g.po3labels.push(b2)
                g.po3names.push(sdName(i, u, gap, -1))

// opening gap: called from 15 minutes before the open (hint, price = current close)
// and on the open bar (final, price = open)
method rends(RTHOG g, float opv) =>
    g.op := opv
    g.tend := time
    g.xhi := high
    g.xlo := low
    int x1 = tright(xoff)
    int x0 = g.tend - tfms * rdx
    string nm = timestr()
    float mid = math.avg(g.cl, g.op)
    bool up = g.op > g.cl
    rmLine(g.mline)
    rmLabel(g.mlabel)
    rmLine(g.opline)
    rmLabel(g.oplabel)
    rmBox(g.rect)
    g.rect := na
    [l1, b1] = mkLL(x0, x1, mid, attL(lrgapcolor, 0), rgaplnsty, attW(rgapwid, 0), "RTHOG ce " + nm,
         attL(lrgapcolor, 0))
    g.mline := l1
    g.mlabel := b1
    [l2, b2] = mkLL(g.tend, x1, g.op, attL(lrgapcolor, 0), rgaplnsty, attW(rgapwid, 0),
         (up ? "RTHOG hi " : "RTHOG lo ") + nm, attL(lrgapcolor, 0))
    g.opline := l2
    g.oplabel := b2
    if not na(g.clabel)
        g.clabel.set_text((up ? "RTHOG lo " : "RTHOG hi ") + nm)
    if dogrect
        g.rect := box.new(x0, g.op, x1, g.cl, xloc = xloc.bar_time, border_color = transparent,
             bgcolor = color.new(lrgapcolor, attT(grtransp, 0)))
    g.killq()
    g.killpo3()
    g.killoct()
    if dorthogq
        g.rquads()
    if dorthogoct
        g.roct()
    if dorthogpo3
        g.rpo3()

// compact version for gaps older than the previous one
method setOld(RTHOG g) =>
    g.isold := true
    bool complete = not na(g.tend) and not na(g.op) and not na(g.cl)
    g.kill()
    if complete
        int d = tfms * rdx
        float mid = math.avg(g.cl, g.op)
        [l1, b1] = mkLL(g.tstart - d, g.tstart + d, g.cl, attL(rgapcolor, 2), rgaplnsty, attW(rgapwid, 2), "rthog.cl",
             attL(color.black, 2))
        g.cline := l1
        g.clabel := b1
        [l2, b2] = mkLL(g.tend - d, g.tend + d, g.cl, attL(rgapcolor, 2), rgaplnsty, attW(rgapwid, 2), "rthog.cl",
             attL(color.black, 2))
        g.cline2 := l2
        g.clabel2 := b2
        [l3, b3] = mkLL(g.tend - d, g.tend + d, mid, attL(rgapcolor, 2), rgaplnsty, attW(rgapwid, 2), "rthog.ce",
             attL(color.black, 2))
        g.mline := l3
        g.mlabel := b3
        [l4, b4] = mkLL(g.tend - d, g.tend + d, g.op, attL(rgapcolor, 2), rgaplnsty, attW(rgapwid, 2), "rthog.op",
             attL(color.black, 2))
        g.opline := l4
        g.oplabel := b4
        if extendgaps
            g.cline2.set_extend(extend.right)
            g.mline.set_extend(extend.right)
            g.opline.set_extend(extend.right)

// right-edge update, last bar only
// [ATT] rk: rank of the gap (0 current, 1 previous); quadrants and stddevs are minor
method right(RTHOG g, color c0, int rk) =>
    if not g.isold
        int x = tright(xoff)
        color c = attL(c0, rk)
        color cm = attL(c0, 2)
        int w = attW(rgapwid, rk)
        setR(g.cline, g.clabel, x, c, w)
        setR(g.mline, g.mlabel, x, c, w)
        setR(g.opline, g.oplabel, x, c, w)
        setR(g.uqline, g.uqlabel, x, cm)
        setR(g.dqline, g.dqlabel, x, cm)
        if not na(g.rect)
            g.rect.set_right(x)
            g.rect.set_bgcolor(color.new(lrgapcolor, attT(grtransp, rk)))
        if not na(g.po3lines)
            for l in g.po3lines
                l.set_x2(x)
                l.set_color(cm)
            for b in g.po3labels
                b.set_x(x)
                b.set_textcolor(cm)

bool mktEnds = market.ends()
bool mktClose = mktEnds and not mktEnds[1]
int dOpen = (market.ss - tsec + 86400) % 86400
bool rthStarting = dOpen < tfsecs + 900     // bars from 15 min before the open up to the open bar
bool rthOpenBar = dOpen < tfsecs            // bar containing the open
bool rthOk = inWin and dogaps and dorthog and tfsecs <= 900 and bar_index > 0
     and last_bar_index - bar_index <= 5000 and dow != dayofweek.sunday

if rthOk
    if mktClose
        RTHOG rt = RTHOG.new()
        rt.rstarts(close[1], time[1])
        if rthogs.size() > 0
            RTHOG pv = rthogs.last()
            pv.killq()
            pv.killpo3()
            pv.killoct()
        if rthogs.size() > 1
            rthogs.get(rthogs.size() - 2).setOld()
        rthogs.push(rt)
        if rthogs.size() > ngapsEff
            rthogs.shift().kill()
    else if rthStarting and rthogs.size() > 0
        RTHOG cg = rthogs.last()
        if not na(cg.cl) and (finalBar or rthOpenBar)
            cg.rends(rthOpenBar ? open : close)
    // automatic stddevs: extremes of the day from the open (open bar included) until the close
    if rthogauto and not mktClose and rthogs.size() > 0
        RTHOG ag = rthogs.last()
        if not na(ag.tend) and time > ag.tend
            ag.xhi := math.max(ag.xhi, high)
            ag.xlo := math.min(ag.xlo, low)
// automatic stddevs: extremes of the latest premarket range from its end until the market close
if preOn and pmauto and premarkets.size() > 0
    Zone az = premarkets.last()
    if not na(az.tend) and time > az.tend and (na(az.tclose) or time < az.tclose)
        az.xhi := na(az.xhi) ? high : math.max(az.xhi, high)
        az.xlo := na(az.xlo) ? low : math.min(az.xlo, low)

// ============================================================ EQH / EQL
float atrv = ta.atr(14)
float ph = ta.pivothigh(high, eqlen, eqlen)
float pl = ta.pivotlow(low, eqlen, eqlen)
int pivT = time[eqlen]

dropFirst(array<Piv> arr, bool wantEq) =>
    for i = 0 to arr.size() - 1
        Piv v = arr.get(i)
        if v.eq == wantEq
            rmLine(v.ln)
            rmLabel(v.lb)
            arr.remove(i)
            break

trimPivs(array<Piv> arr) =>
    int ne = 0
    for v in arr
        if v.eq
            ne += 1
    while ne > eqkeep
        dropFirst(arr, true)
        ne -= 1
    while arr.size() - ne > 30
        dropFirst(arr, false)

sweepPivs(array<Piv> arr, bool isHigh, float tol) =>
    int i = arr.size() - 1
    while i >= 0
        Piv v = arr.get(i)
        float slack = v.eq ? 0.0 : tol
        bool swept = isHigh ? high > v.p + slack : low < v.p - slack
        if swept
            rmLine(v.ln)
            rmLabel(v.lb)
            arr.remove(i)
        i -= 1

addPiv(array<Piv> arr, float p, int t, bool isHigh, float tol) =>
    Piv m = na
    for v in arr
        if math.abs(v.p - p) <= tol
            m := v
            break
    if not na(m)
        if not m.eq
            m.pl := m.p
        m.eq := true
        m.pr := p
        if isHigh ? p > m.p : p < m.p
            m.p := p
    else
        arr.push(Piv.new(p, t))
    trimPivs(arr)

// label: EQH, or eqH when the right swing is higher than the left one (EQL / eqL: lower, for lows)
drawEq(array<Piv> arr, bool isHigh, string sfx, color c) =>
    int x = tright(xoff)
    for v in arr
        if v.eq
            bool up = not na(v.pl) and not na(v.pr) and (isHigh ? v.pr > v.pl : v.pr < v.pl)
            string txt = (up ? (isHigh ? "eqH" : "eqL") : (isHigh ? "EQH" : "EQL")) + sfx
            if na(v.ln)
                v.ln := line.new(v.t, v.p, x, v.p, xloc = xloc.bar_time, color = c, style = eqhlsty,
                     width = attW(eqhlwid, 1))
                v.lb := label.new(x, v.p, txt, xloc = xloc.bar_time, style = label.style_label_left,
                     color = transparent, textcolor = c, size = lblsz,
                     text_formatting = text.format_bold)
            else
                v.ln.set_xy1(v.t, v.p)
                v.ln.set_xy2(x, v.p)
                v.lb.set_xy(x, v.p)
                v.lb.set_text(txt)
    true
// 3-candle swings (one candle on each side), kept until price takes them
float ph3 = ta.pivothigh(high, 1, 1)
float pl3 = ta.pivotlow(low, 1, 1)
var array<float> sh3p = array.new<float>()
var array<int> sh3t = array.new<int>()
var array<float> sl3p = array.new<float>()
var array<int> sl3t = array.new<int>()

sweep3(array<float> ps, array<int> ts, bool isHigh) =>
    int i = ps.size() - 1
    while i >= 0
        if isHigh ? high > ps.get(i) : low < ps.get(i)
            ps.remove(i)
            ts.remove(i)
        i -= 1
    true

add3(array<float> ps, array<int> ts, float p, int t) =>
    ps.push(p)
    ts.push(t)
    if ps.size() > 60
        ps.shift()
        ts.shift()
    true

// the pivot just added at time t (price p) becomes an EQH / EQL when an earlier unswept 3-candle swing
// has the same price or is at most eq3pts beyond it (above for highs, below for lows). The level is the
// swing price, drawn from the swing.
eq3(array<Piv> arr, array<float> ps, array<int> ts, float p, int t, bool isHigh) =>
    if arr.size() > 0
        Piv v = arr.last()
        if v.t == t and not v.eq
            int n = ps.size()
            if n > 0
                for i = n - 1 to 0
                    float q = ps.get(i)
                    int qt = ts.get(i)
                    float d = isHigh ? q - p : p - q
                    if qt < t and d >= 0 and d <= eq3pts
                        v.eq := true
                        v.pl := q
                        v.pr := v.p
                        v.p := q
                        v.t := qt
                        trimPivs(arr)
                        break
    true

if inWin and tfok and doeqhl
    float tol = eqtol * nz(atrv, 0.0)
    sweepPivs(hpv, true, tol)
    sweepPivs(lpv, false, tol)
    sweep3(sh3p, sh3t, true)
    sweep3(sl3p, sl3t, false)
    if not na(ph)
        addPiv(hpv, ph, pivT, true, tol)
        if doeq3
            eq3(hpv, sh3p, sh3t, ph, pivT, true)
    if not na(pl)
        addPiv(lpv, pl, pivT, false, tol)
        if doeq3
            eq3(lpv, sl3p, sl3t, pl, pivT, false)
    if not na(ph3)
        add3(sh3p, sh3t, ph3, time[1])
    if not na(pl3)
        add3(sl3p, sl3t, pl3, time[1])

// daily swings: previous completed daily bar only (lookahead_on with [1]), so nothing repaints
[dph, dpl, dpt, datr, dtm] = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "D",
     [ta.pivothigh(high, eqlenD, eqlenD)[1], ta.pivotlow(low, eqlenD, eqlenD)[1], time[eqlenD + 1],
     ta.atr(14)[1], time],
     lookahead = barmerge.lookahead_on)
bool newDBar = dtm != nz(dtm[1], dtm)

if inWin and tfok and doeqhl and doeqd
    float tolD = eqtol * nz(datr, 0.0)
    sweepPivs(hpvD, true, tolD)
    sweepPivs(lpvD, false, tolD)
    if newDBar
        if not na(dph)
            addPiv(hpvD, dph, dpt, true, tolD)
        if not na(dpl)
            addPiv(lpvD, dpl, dpt, false, tolD)

// ============================================================ months
getm(MonLn m, int t, float p, color c, string txt) =>
    if na(m.ln)
        m.ln := line.new(t, p, t + tfms, p, xloc = xloc.bar_time, extend = extend.right, color = attL(c, 0),
             width = attW(monwid, 0), style = monsty)
        m.lbl := label.new(tright(xoff), p, txt, xloc = xloc.bar_time,
             style = label.style_label_left, color = transparent, textcolor = attL(c, 0))
    else
        m.ln.set_xy1(t, p)
        m.ln.set_xy2(t + tfms, p)
        m.lbl.set_xy(tright(xoff), p)
        m.lbl.set_text(txt)
    true
drawMonth(int idx, float h, float l, float c, int t, int tc) =>
    if not na(h) and not na(t)
        string suf = " " + str.format_time(t + 7 * 86400000, "MMM") + "\n"
        getm(mls.get(idx * 3), t, h, monmaxcol, "max" + suf)
        getm(mls.get(idx * 3 + 1), t, l, monmincol, "min" + suf)
        getm(mls.get(idx * 3 + 2), tc, c, monccol, "close" + suf)

[mh1, ml1, mc1, mt1, mtc1,
     mh2, ml2, mc2, mt2, mtc2,
     mh3, ml3, mc3, mt3, mtc3] = request.security(syminfo.tickerid, "M",
     [high[1], low[1], close[1], time[1], time,
     high[2], low[2], close[2], time[2], time[1],
     high[3], low[3], close[3], time[3], time[2]],
     lookahead = barmerge.lookahead_on)

// ============================================================ RTHOG / premarket stddev labels
// stddev lines of the RTHOG and the premarket range at almost the same price share one
// label: "RTHOG+0.5 PMKT+1". The other label is emptied.
combinePo3(RTHOG g, Zone z, float tol) =>
    if not na(g.po3labels) and not na(z.sdlabels) and not na(g.po3names) and not na(z.sdnames)
        for [k, l] in g.po3labels
            l.set_text("RTHOG" + g.po3names.get(k))
        for [k, l] in z.sdlabels
            l.set_text("PMKT" + z.sdnames.get(k))
        array<bool> used = array.new<bool>(z.sdlabels.size(), false)
        for [k, l] in g.po3labels
            for [m, q] in z.sdlabels
                if not used.get(m) and math.abs(l.get_y() - q.get_y()) <= tol
                    l.set_text("RTHOG" + g.po3names.get(k) + " PMKT" + z.sdnames.get(m))
                    q.set_text("")
                    used.set(m, true)
                    break
    true

// ============================================================ last-bar work: right edges, months,
// table
var table tbl = table.new(position.top_right, 1, 4, bgcolor = transparent)

bool inMacro = false
if domacrobg and tfok and tfsecs < 900  // not on 15m and above
    for m in macros
        if m.inside(tsec)
            inMacro := true
            break
bgcolor(inMacro ? attL(macrobgcolor, 1) : na)

if finalBar and tfok
    if doreh and dodaylbl and dodmaxmin
        markRel(days, reltol * nz(datr, 0.0))
    for z in days
        if z.live()
            z.refresh()
    for z in zones
        if z.live()
            z.refresh()
    for z in premarkets
        if z.live()
            z.refresh()
    if preOn
        int npm = premarkets.size()
        for [i, z] in premarkets
            if i >= npm - pmkeep
                z.pmdraw(pmauto and i == npm - 1)
            else
                z.pmclear()
    float gtol = combtol * nz(datr, 0.0)
    for [i, g] in dgaps
        g.imp := i == dgaps.size() - 1
    if combgaps
        combineGaps(dgaps, wgaps, gtol)
    else
        for g in dgaps
            g.gright(gtol)
        for g in wgaps
            g.gright(gtol)
    if rthogauto and dorthogpo3 and rthogs.size() > 0
        RTHOG lg = rthogs.last()
        if not na(lg.tend) and not na(lg.op) and not na(lg.cl) and not lg.isold
            lg.rpo3()
    for [i, g] in rthogs
        if i == rthogs.size() - 1
            g.right(lrgapcolor, 0)
            g.octRight(attL(lrgapcolor, 2))    // octants: latest RTHOG only (removed at the close, like the quadrants)
        else if i == rthogs.size() - 2
            g.right(rgapcolor, 1)
    if preOn and rthogs.size() > 0 and premarkets.size() > 0
        combinePo3(rthogs.last(), premarkets.last(), pmctol * nz(datr, 0.0))
    if doeqhl
        drawEq(hpv, true, "", attL(eqhcol, 1))
        drawEq(lpv, false, "", attL(eqlcol, 1))
        if doeqd
            drawEq(hpvD, true, " D", attL(eqhcol, 1))
            drawEq(lpvD, false, " D", attL(eqlcol, 1))
    if domonth
        drawMonth(0, mh1, ml1, mc1, mt1, mtc1)
        drawMonth(1, mh2, ml2, mc2, mt2, mtc2)
        drawMonth(2, mh3, ml3, mc3, mt3, mtc3)

    string sname = ""
    if dozones
        for zi in zinfos
            if zi.inside(tsec)
                sname := zi.name
                break
    string mname = ""
    if domacros
        for m in macros
            if m.inside(tsec)
                mname := m.name
                break
    string bname = ""
    if dosilver
        for m in sbs
            if not na(m) and m.inside(tsec)
                bname := m.name
                break
    table.cell(tbl, 0, 0, sname, text_color = zonecolor, text_size = size.large)
    table.cell(tbl, 0, 1, mname, text_color = macrocolor, text_size = size.large)
    table.cell(tbl, 0, 2, bname, text_color = silvercolor, text_size = size.large)
    table.cell(tbl, 0, 3, showcap and capped ? "object cap: " + str.tostring(ndaysEff) + " days"
         : "", text_color = color.orange, text_size = size.tiny)
